ceremony-details: Please arrive 30 minutes early to be seated. Valet parking will be available on-site for your convenience. The ceremony will be outdoors — we recommend light, comfortable formal attire.
reception-details: Please join us for an evening of celebration filled with yummy food, strong drinks, and good tunes all night — we can’t wait to party with you!!
itinerary-subheader: Here’s a look at the special moments planned for our big day.
welcome-itinerary-description: Grab a seat, relax, and enjoy the calm before the happy tears start.
ceremony-itinerary-description: Join us for a heartfelt ceremony as we officially begin this new chapter together.
cocktails-itinerary-description: Sip, mingle, and enjoy good company while we sneak off for a few photos and a quick breather before the party starts.
reception-itinerary-description: Celebrate with us over good food, good company, and a night of music and dancing.
our-story-paragraph-1: We met the modern way — matching on Hinge and hoping for the best. One chat turned into a date, then another, and eventually into weekends full of coffee dates, inside jokes, and realizing we might’ve found the real thing.
our-story-paragraph-2: We’re so excited to celebrate this next chapter with the people who’ve been cheering us on!
our-story-paragraph-3: TL;DR: We met on Hinge and it actually worked :)
rsvp-subheader: Can we count you in? Please RSVP by January 20, 2026 so we can plan accordingly.
solo-rsvp-message: Please let us know if you’ll be joining us.
group-rsvp-message: Please let us know who from your group will be joining us.
contact-info-message: Please share your contact info — we might have a little something to send your way
optional-message-placeholder: Add a personal note or details about your RSVP.
please-select-at-least-one-guest: Who’s coming? Select at least one guest to join the fun!
rsvp-success-message: Thank you for letting us know!
rsvp-already-submitted-message: It looks like you’ve already submitted your RSVP. If you need to make changes, please contact us directly.
additional-details-subheader: Here’s everything you might want to know to help plan your time with us.
dress-code-description: Formal attire, please. Think: suits or dress shirts + ties for the guys, and evening-elegant outfits for the ladies. We can’t wait to see everyone looking their best!
parking-description: Complimentary parking is available at the venue. If you’re planning to enjoy drinks (which we fully support), rideshare is the way to go.
reception-menu-description: Dinner will be casual buffet style with food stations, featuring a mix of our favorite comfort foods: tacos and pho. Grab a plate, build your bowl, try everything, and go back for seconds!
travel-description: For those traveling in, here are a few hotel options nearby: Kodō Hotel, InterContinental Los Angeles Downtown, Hotel Figueroa.
kids-description: We love your little ones, but our wedding will be an adults-only celebration. Take the night off, enjoy a child-free evening, and come ready to relax, eat, drink, and dance with us!
gifts-description: Your presence means the world to us! But if you’d like to contribute to our home + future adventures, we are registered at Minted. And cards are always welcome - Mio will absolutely read it and treasure it forever (no pressure).
gift-message: Your presence is the best gift! If you’d like to give a gift, you can find our registry at Minted.
thank-you-message: Thank you for celebrating with us! After the wedding, please return to this website to see all the photos and relive the memories from our special day.
